prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on growth: profit grew 41% compared with a year earlier. Also in its favour: sales grew 29% compared with a year earlier; profit covers interest costs 5.5 times over; and debt is lower than shareholders' equity (debt-to-equity 0.44). Other areas on this side: the balance sheet, risk, the recent price trend.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 10.6% lower than a year ago. Also against it: over the past year the share did 8.9 percentage points worse than the Nifty 50; quality scores only 33 of 100 against the comparison pool; and value scores only 34 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: the quality of the business, what the price asks for the earnings.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 6 points in favour and 4 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 40 of 100. The side that carries most weight is growth. That gives an educational rating of Hold with medium confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
